contract:
Loaded by profile.html:20 and messages.html:17. No other area owns it.

STYLE block (:25-326): add
- `.vpv-edit`: width 100%, min-height 120px, font 15px 'DM Sans', border 1px solid rgba(28,28,30,.14), border-radius 12px, padding 10px 12px, resize vertical, box-sizing border-box
- `.vpv-edit-row`: flex, space-between, align center, margin-top 8px, gap 8px
- `.vpv-edit-hint`: 12px, #8A8580
- `.vpv-edit-btn`: pill buttons; `.vpv-edit-btn.primary` has #1C1C1E background and white text

state (:446-468): add `editing: false, editedAt: null, hasMedia: false, tags: [], author: null, createdAt: null`.

renderFromServer (:668-735):
- Set `state.editedAt = p.edited_at || null; state.hasMedia = !!p.media_url; state.tags = p.tags || []; state.author = p.author || null; state.createdAt = p.created_at || null;`
- Pass `edited_at: p.edited_at` to paintHeader.
- Owner menu (:717-718): ``menu.innerHTML = `<button type="button" onclick="window.__vpvCloseMenu();window.__vpvStartEdit()">Edit post</button><button type="button" class="danger" onclick="window.__vpvDeletePost()">Delete post</button>`;``

paintHeader (:781-796): accepts `edited_at`. `sub = [handle, when, edited_at ? "Edited" : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")`. Set `vpvSub.title = edited_at ? "Edited " + new Date(edited_at).toLocaleString() : ""`.

NEW `window.__vpvStartEdit()`:
- Guards: state.openId, state.isOwner, isAppShell(), isRealPostId(state.openId), !state.editing.
- Set `state.editing = true`.
- In #vpvBody, replace ONLY the `.vpv-text` node (or insert a wrapper as the first child when there is no text). Media and the video element stay untouched, so playback isn't reset.
- The editor: `<textarea class="vpv-edit" id="vpvEditInput" maxlength="2000">` with the value set via `.value = state.content` (never innerHTML), plus a `.vpv-edit-row` holding:
  - `<span class="vpv-edit-hint" id="vpvEditHint">`: `{n}/2000`, followed by either " · You can change the words. The photo or video stays." when state.hasMedia, or " · Your post can't be empty." when the post has no media and the text is empty
  - Cancel (`__vpvCancelEdit()`) and Save (`id=vpvEditSave`, class primary, `__vpvSaveEdit()`, disabled until changed and valid)
- `window.vibeBindMentionPicker(textarea)` if present.
- Textarea keydown: Escape does `e.stopPropagation()` and cancels, so the document Escape handler at :426 does not close the post; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter saves.

`__vpvCancelEdit(force)`: if dirty && !force && !confirm("Discard your changes?") return. Restore the `.vpv-text` node from state.content via formatBodyText, then `state.editing = false`.

`__vpvSaveEdit()`:
- `const id = state.openId`. If state.inflight, return. Set inflight=true and Save to "Saving…" disabled.
- `const r = await window.vibeRequest('/api/posts/' + encodeURIComponent(id), { method: 'PATCH', json: { content: value }, failure: "Couldn't save your changes." })`.
- If `state.openId !== id`, return (the viewer was closed or switched).
- If `r.ok && r.data && r.data.post`:
  - Update state.content, state.tags and state.editedAt.
  - Swap the text node (formatBodyText) or remove it if empty; swap or remove the `.vpv-tags` block (esc each tag).
  - `paintHeader({ author: state.author, created_at: state.createdAt, edited_at: state.editedAt })`; `window.vibeToast('Post updated')`.
  - `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vibe:post-edited', { detail: { id, content: state.content, tags: state.tags, edited_at: state.editedAt } }))`; `state.editing = false`.
- Else re-enable Save (vibeRequest toasted).
- `finally inflight = false`.

Reset `state.editing = false` in renderLoading (:629) and closeViewer (:592).
acceptance: Desktop /profile (own): open a post, then ⋯ shows Edit post / Delete post. Edit swaps the text for a textarea without restarting a playing video. Save updates the text, tags and "· Edited" header, and toasts "Post updated".
Escape while editing cancels the edit only; the modal stays open. A second Escape closes the modal.
Content containing <script> or "quotes" round-trips escaped (textarea .value, formatBodyText on repaint).
Opening another post mid-save does not paint the first post's edit into the second (openId guard).
On a non-owned post the menu is unchanged (Report / Mute / Block).
